claims.claim: Real/fake linear probing compares six frozen feature backbones and within/cross StableDiffusion1.4/2.0 settings on caption-linked COCOFake semantic clusters.
A second analysis measures caption-semantic preservation through exact-pair and intra-cluster retrieval; it is distinct from authenticity classification.

policy_analysis: LockedR3 is supported by primary contribution framing and multiple independently defined empirical questions: feature-family detectability, caption preservation and semantic/style projection probing. Exact protocols, metrics and comparative Tables1-5 substantiate a systematic analysis; this does not rely solely on a large table, released dataset, t-SNE figure or supporting robustness ablation. Preserve method;dataset and detection; add only analysis_study. No benchmark question is introduced.
caveats: Only two versions of the same StableDiffusion generator family are evaluated here; cross-version results are not universal cross-generator generalization.
Learned projections encourage semantic/style separation. They do not independently prove that all low-level cues are removed or causally isolate semantics.
Overall accuracy uses the documented evaluation composition; training balances one randomly selected fake per real cluster, while full dataset clusters contain five generated children.
Table2 99.68 is validation accuracy; corresponding SD1.4 test accuracy is99.64. Preserve split labels.
Authorv2 Table3 contains literal .63.26 and nonmonotonic R@3/R@5 entries in some rows; retain source anomalies rather than silently repair them. These cells are not used to authorize theR3 addition.
No complete publisher-final manuscript was inspected. DOI/title/byline match is bibliographic correspondence, not proof of identical final numerical content.
